Name: Santas Xmas Dash II
Overview:
Santas Xmas Dash is back and better than before!

Help Santa deliver the presents, with all the great features of the first game plus a new multiplayer race mode and single player 60 second dash. With added support for the thumbstick and left/right triggers its more challenging than it ever was.

Watch as events scroll on from the left giving you time to prepare for each event.
